tspan.tspan: 需要精确计算余弦加权投影

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 计算半张角 γ、球冠高度 u = 1 - cos γ 的球冠面光源或天窗辐照度?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 忽略球冠边缘斜射余弦衰减 · 在 60° 偏离 25%、在 90° 半球整整相差两倍 π vs 2π!

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 已知参数是半张角正弦 sin γ 还是球冠立体角 Ω = 2πu?

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 采用 Lambert 1760 圆盘投影律: Ω_⊥ = π * sin²γ

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 乘以球冠平均余弦: Ω_⊥ = Ω * 1 + cos γ / 2 = Ω * 1 - 0.5u

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 严格对齐阿基米德帽盒均值 · 全 17 站恒锁 R = 1.0000× · 0/17 失配 · 提速 11.89×
